visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female dermatologist with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a white sleeveless blouse, is seen performing a medical aesthetic procedure on a patient's face in a clean, brightly lit clinic. She uses a white handpiece labeled 'Thermage' on the patient's jawline, which has pink grid markings and clear gel applied. (2) The video cuts to a multi-window live stream interface showing several young women in black outfits posing together. This is a brief visual interjection illustrating a 'thin face' archetype mentioned in the dialogue. The screen is filled with digital icons, text, and heart emojis typical of social media platforms. (3) The scene returns to the dermatologist in the clinical setting, who continues to apply the Thermage treatment to the patient's lower face. She explains the rationale for treatment choices based on facial structure. The background features clinical equipment and organized storage typical of a professional medical office. (4) A humorous cartoon overlay of SpongeBob SquarePants with an exaggerated, square jawline appears on screen. This visual metaphor is used to illustrate the concept of a 'square face' being discussed, contrasting with the previous thin-face example. (5) The final shot is a static information screen with a gray and white background. It displays the 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' logo in black, followed by contact details including a LINE ID, phone number, and two physical addresses for their Taipei-based branches.
